operations.description: Search issues by JQL, one page per call; a JQL `updated >=` clause filters by time, and the walk ends on a page without nextPageToken
List one issue's comments, one page per call; the walk ends when startAt plus the page's comments reaches total
List one issue's changelog, one page per call; the walk ends on a page with isLast true
Read one issue by id or key, with the fields named in fields (default all fields, attachment among them) and the expansions named in expand, such as renderedFields,names

List the transitions the account may run on one issue by id or key, each with its target status in to; transitionId narrows to one, expand=transitions.fields adds the transition screen's fields, includeUnavailableTransitions=true adds those that fail a condition
List the issue types the account can create in one project, by id or key, one page per call; the walk ends when startAt plus the page's issueTypes reaches total
Find active users whose display name or email address starts with query, or by exact accountId, one page per call of the first 1,000 matches; the walk ends on an empty page

Read one attachment's content by its id, as issue.get lists it under fields.attachment. Answers the bytes in base64 with their media_type, length and sha256, refused above 2 MiB. With redirect false Jira answers the content itself; otherwise it answers 303 to a download URL, which is followed only to api.media.atlassian.com, and only when the connection admits that host, without the connection's credential

Run one transition on one issue by id or key: body.transition.id names it, and fields and update set the transition screen's fields. Refused before the write unless the issue's status id is current_status and the transition is open on it with target status id target_status; Jira answers 204, and the issue read again after the write must be in target_status
